narrative.overview:
A mid-century physics-education poster rendered for the web. Two wave sources, Physics and Code, interfere, and what a recruiter hires is the interference between them. Everything is flat silkscreen ink: two spot inks (ultramarine and vermilion) on cool blue-tinted paper, set in blue-black ink. There are no gradients, no glow, and no soft shadows. Overprint is by multiply, never by opacity haze.

The page reads as a ruled, captioned plate. Sections are ledgers: a 2px ink rule on top, hairlines between rows, one caption line under a heavy wide headline. The interface recedes so the work leads. Density is generous: one idea per screen, large section padding, long measure capped near 68ch.

The system is recognizable with all content removed by concentric-ring moire on ultramarine.
keyCharacteristics: Two spot inks plus paper and blue-black ink; grounds alternate paper, paper-2, ultramarine, vermilion.
One typeface (Archivo, variable width and weight): wide and heavy for display, normal width for text.
Square, flat, hairline-ruled; zero radius everywhere except store app icons.
One authored motion moment (the hero ring tank); everything else is a state change.
Poster grammar: caption bars, figure captions, registered rail.

rules.name: The Two Inks Rule
rules.body: Ultramarine and vermilion are the only chromatic colors. A third hue is a different poster.

rules.name: The No-Vermilion-Text Rule
rules.body: On paper, vermilion text fails; use Vermilion Ink or Blue-Black Ink. On vermilion grounds, text is Blue-Black Ink.

rules.name: The Flat Ink Rule
rules.body: Fills are solid. No gradients, glow, or translucent tints standing in for a color.

rules.name: The Wide Heavy Display Rule
rules.body: Display and headings are Archivo 800 at stretched width; text is never stretched.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Archivo throughout. Do not pair a second face.

rules.name: The Ledger Rule
rules.body: Experience, skills, projects, education, certifications, and apps share one grammar: a 2px ink top rule, 1px rules between rows, no cards, no boxes.

rules.name: The Registered Rail Rule
rules.body: Experience carries a single rail: past roles are a 1px hairline with a hollow square marker; the current role is a 4px solid vermilion bar with a solid vermilion marker.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Page surfaces carry no box-shadow. Separation comes from rules and grounds.

dos: Do set every text color from Blue-Black Ink, Ink Soft, white, or Ultramarine Mist, matched to the ground.
Do build new reading sections as ledgers: 2px ink top rule, 1px rule rows, Title-type row heads.
Do head each section with a Headline-type title and one caption line (max 46ch).
Do keep buttons square, flat, uppercase label type, in one of three inks (vermilion, line, ink).
Do alternate grounds (paper, paper-2, ultramarine, vermilion) and let ground change do the separating.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion and pointer: coarse for any animated figure; keep motion to state changes otherwise.
Do use the 3px offset focus ring in the ground's focus color.
donts: Don't use vermilion (#ff4b1f) as text on paper; use Vermilion Ink (#b82d0a).
Don't add gradients, glows, or soft shadows to page surfaces.
Don't introduce a third hue or a second typeface.
Don't round corners on chrome or wrap content in cards; use rules.
Don't add scroll-reveal animations; the page has none.
Don't use the retired neon green/cyan identity or the legacy stylesheets (aos.css, main.css, bootstrap), which index.html no longer loads.
